# Mapbox data catalog
Generated 2026-11-03. Page: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/. Each dataset has a permalink (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#<slug>); the page itself is static HTML with the same content.
Datasets reach an agent three ways: the hosted runtime MCP server (https://mcp.mapbox.com/mcp) for search, geocoding, routing, matrices, isochrones and map matching;
the DevKit MCP server (https://mcp-devkit.mapbox.com/mcp) for point lookups into any vector tileset (Tilequery) plus styles and tokens;
and REST with an access token for tiles, rasters, files and feeds. Datasets marked Contact sales need a contract before a token works (https://www.mapbox.com/contact/sales/).
Sign up for a token: https://account.mapbox.com/auth/signup/ . Pricing: https://www.mapbox.com/pricing . Docs index: https://docs.mapbox.com/llms.txt
Handling rules: longitude then latitude; store the retrieval time, source URL, product version and area with any result; typical traffic is historical and Places activity is historical busyness;
Movement never exposes individual trajectories; treat 401 and 403 as a missing contract or token scope and 429 as a rate limit.

## Basemap
The layers of the Mapbox base map: roads, buildings, land, water, places and labels, plus satellite imagery and 3D landmarks.

### Roads, paths and rail
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#roads-paths-and-rail
Domain: Basemap
Status: Available (GA)
Description: The road, path and rail network, classified by function and importance, with names, surface, one-way direction and access restrictions
How it ships: Vector tiles
APIs and interfaces: SDK; Tilequery API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/tilequery/); Static Images API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/static-images/); Vector Tiles API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/vector-tiles/)
Format: Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT)
Data type: Vector (lines, polygons, points)
Updated: Continuous. Edits from OpenStreetMap and from Mapbox's own data program flow into the tiles as they land, so there is no release cycle to wait for. Automated checks catch suspicious edits such as vandalism or mass deletions and hold them for a person to review before they reach the map.
Resolution / zoom range: z0 to z16 (house numbers at z16)
Price: PAYGO: Vector Tiles API requests; Maps SDK loads / MAU
License terms: Attribution required; no raw export or derivative dataset under standard ToS (confirm with Legal)
Model training allowed: No
Useful for: Base map rendering, feature lookup (Tilequery), custom cartography
Source: Mapbox proprietary data + OpenStreetMap, Microsoft Open Maps, Wikidata; Zenrin (Japan). Coverage template sources: OSM; Zenrin (Japan); GeoTech as alternative
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/data/tilesets/reference/mapbox-streets-v8/#road

### 3D landmarks
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#3d-landmarks
Domain: Basemap
Status: Available (GA)
Description: 3D models for key landmarks
How it ships: SDK featureset
APIs and interfaces: SDK
Format: Maps SDK Interactions / featuresets
Data type: 3D models and attributes
Updated: With Standard style releases
Resolution / zoom range: Style-dependent
Price: Included in Maps SDK / GL JS usage
License terms: SDK ToS
Model training allowed: No
Useful for: Interactive basemap features, 3D cities
Source: Streets v8 + landmarks, 3D models, indoor and HD road data. Coverage template sources: OSM (open)
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/map-styles/reference/standard/

### Satellite imagery
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#satellite-imagery
Domain: Basemap
Status: Available (GA)
Description: Global basemap of high resolution satellite and aerial imagery
How it ships: Raster tiles
APIs and interfaces: SDK; Tilequery API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/tilequery/); Static Images API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/static-images/); Raster Tiles API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/raster-tiles/)
Format: JPEG/PNG/WebP raster tiles
Data type: Raster
Updated: Rolling refresh by region
Resolution / zoom range: Up to z22 in high-res areas (confirm)
Price: PAYGO: Raster Tiles API requests
License terms: Attribution required; vendor restrictions on reuse
Model training allowed: No
Useful for: Imagery basemap, hybrid maps, site inspection
Source: Maxar; Airbus as alternative
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/data/tilesets/reference/mapbox-satellite/

Status: Available (GA)

How it ships: Vector tiles

Format: MVT
Data type: Vector (polygons)
Price: Free
Source: LSIB, Natural Earth, OSM (open); GfK; eMapGo for China (license ended 2022); 2,000+ authoritative sources per product page
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/data/tilesets/reference/mapbox-countries-v1/

### Bathymetry
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#bathymetry
Domain: Basemap
Status: Available (GA)
Description: Provides underwater depth of sea floor at discrete minimum depth levels. The purpose of this tileset is to add ocean detail at low zoom levels.
How it ships: Vector tiles
APIs and interfaces: SDK; Tilequery API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/tilequery/); Static Images API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/static-images/); Vector Tiles API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/vector-tiles/)

## Terrain
Elevation, contour lines, hillshade and land cover for the whole world.

### Elevation raster
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#elevation-raster
Domain: Terrain
Status: Available (GA)
Description: Raster tileset of a global elevation layer
How it ships: Raster tiles
APIs and interfaces: SDK; Tilequery API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/tilequery/); Static Images API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/static-images/); Raster Tiles API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/raster-tiles/)
Format: PNG, elevation encoded in RGB
Data type: Raster
Updated: Static

## Boundaries
Administrative, postal, statistical, locality and legislative boundaries for analytics, mapping and data enrichment.

### Mapbox Boundaries
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#mapbox-boundaries
Domain: Boundaries
Status: Available (Commercial (sales-led))
Description: Global boundary datasets for analytics, mapping, and data enrichment
How it ships: Flat file
APIs and interfaces: License gives you access to tilesets or GeoJSON files with raw geometry and metadata
Format: Vector tiles (MVT); GeoJSONL files
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/data/boundaries/
Layers inside: Administrative (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#administrative): Divisions within a country or territory delineated for general administration, usually with a capital and a government that can set laws and collect taxes. Five levels from countries (adm0) to fourth-level areas (adm4), plus boundary lines and label points.; Postal (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#postal): Approximate mail-delivery areas built from national postal code systems. Three grouping levels (pos1 to pos3) above the full-detail postal code (pos4).; Statistical (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#statistical): Non-administrative boundaries used mainly for statistics: areas defined by a statistical bureau, or historical boundaries still used for reporting (for example US census units). Five levels from the coarsest reporting region (sta1) to the finest (sta5).; Locality (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#locality): Places people recognize as a 'place' even when they are not official boundaries: metropolitan areas, cities and towns, districts and neighborhoods.; Legislative (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#legislative): Constituency areas for legislative assemblies and councils, where voters typically elect one representative per area. Five levels from national upper houses (leg1) to local councils (leg5).

## Search
The address, place and POI data behind geocoding and search.

### Places POI dataset

Format: JSON
Data type: Points with attributes
Updated: Live
Resolution / zoom range: 4 variants; see each
Price: PAYGO per request or session
License terms: API ToS: results may not be cached beyond permitted window; no bulk harvesting
Model training allowed: No
Useful for: Place enrichment: hours, photos, activity, entrances
Source: OSM + Dataplor + TripAdvisor (POIs, open + bought + enriched)
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/places/

URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#address-dataset

Format: JSON / GeoJSON
Data type: Points with attributes
Updated: Live
Resolution / zoom range: n/a (computed per request)
Price: PAYGO per request
License terms: API ToS: results may not be cached beyond permitted window; no bulk harvesting
Model training allowed: No
Useful for: Address lookup, reverse geocoding, batch geocoding
Source: OSM; Remax (US addresses); Lightbox (CA); Loveland (sub-units); ATTOM (US address and neighborhood); AccuZIP (US postal); Loqate fallback and Deyde (SA, EU, ME) for geocoding
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/

Status: Available (GA)

APIs and interfaces: SDK; Tilequery API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/tilequery/); Static Images API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/static-images/); Vector Tiles API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/maps/vector-tiles/)
Format: MVT
Data type: Vector
Source: MapsPeople; Pointr as alternative
Docs: https://docs.mapbox.com/data/tilesets/reference/mapbox-indoor-v3/
Layers inside: Indoor structure (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-structure): Contains building and structure geometries for indoor-mapped venues.; Indoor floor (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-floor): Contains floor geometries within structures; Indoor floorplan (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-floorplan): Contains detailed floorplan elements such as rooms, amenities, corridors, and points of interest within a floor.; Indoor door (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-door): Contains door features within indoor venues, including standard doors, external doors, elevator doors, and openings.; Indoor label (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-label): Contains label points for various indoor features including buildings, floors, rooms, amenities, gates, and points of interest; Indoor facility metadata (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-facility-metadata): Contains metadata about indoor facilities (venues). Each feature represents a facility and provides identifying information.; Indoor structure metadata (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-structure-metadata): Contains metadata about structures (buildings) within indoor-mapped venues.; Indoor floor metadata (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#indoor-floor-metadata): Contains metadata about floors within structures.

## Movement

### Movement
URL: https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#movement-56

Status: Available (Commercial (sales-led))
Description: Movement index with total, driving and non-driving telemetry, gives the customer the ability to analyse trends and compare different regions

APIs and interfaces: Annual license gives access to the selected countries
Format: CSV
Data type: Tabular (activity index)
Updated: Daily and monthly; delivered ~2 weeks after contract
Resolution / zoom range: 100 m tiles (z18) and select Boundaries
Price: Enterprise license; contact sales; sample data for evaluation
License terms: No individual trajectories; contract terms on derivatives
Model training allowed: By contract
Useful for: Footfall, site selection, mobility analytics; candidate AI context layer
Source: De-identified, aggregated mobile device activity from Mapbox telemetry. Coverage template sources: Mapbox telemetry (in-house)
Docs: https://www.mapbox.com/movement-data
Layers inside: Monthly activity (https://hey.mapbox.com/data-catalogV2/#monthly-activity): Aggregated device activity by area and time
